family.hero: Capturing life's most precious moments with artistry and heart. From the anticipation of new life to the joy of family connections, we create timeless images you'll treasure forever.
family.intro: Every family has a story worth telling. Whether you're expecting a new addition, celebrating your newborn's first days, or simply want to freeze time with those you love most, I'm here to create images that you'll treasure for generations. My approach is relaxed, authentic, and focused on capturing the real connections that make your family unique.
family.sessionsIntro: Each session is tailored to your family's unique story, capturing your milestone moments with artistry and care.
family.maternityDescription: Elegant sessions celebrating the beauty of pregnancy, whether in studio with flowing gowns or outdoors in nature.

family.questionsIntro: Everything you need to know about your photography session.
family.faqMaternity: When is the best time for a maternity session?
family.faqMaternityAnswer: The ideal time is between 28-34 weeks of pregnancy when your bump is beautifully round but you're still comfortable. We recommend booking your session in advance to secure your preferred date.
family.faqBaby: How old should my baby be for a newborn session?
family.faqBabyAnswer: The best time is within the first 5-14 days after birth when babies are sleepier and more flexible for those curled-up poses. However, we can capture beautiful images at any age!
family.faqWear: What should we wear for a family session?
family.faqWearAnswer: We recommend coordinating colors rather than matching outfits. Soft, neutral tones photograph beautifully. We offer a complimentary wardrobe consultation to help you prepare.
family.faqHome: Can you come to our home for sessions?
family.faqHomeAnswer: Absolutely! In-home sessions are perfect for newborn and family photography. Your home provides a comfortable, personal setting that creates meaningful images.
family.faqDelivery: How long until we receive our photos?
family.faqDeliveryAnswer: Your private online gallery will be ready within 2-3 weeks after your session. You'll receive a link to view, download, and share your images.
family.faqPrintAnswer: Yes! We offer beautiful albums, canvas prints, and fine art prints. There's nothing quite like holding your memories in your hands.

pets.title: Pet Photography
pets.hero: Capture the spirit and personality of your furry family members with our professional pet photography services
pets.homeDescription: This session takes place in your pet's own environment, where they're most comfortable.
pets.raw: Option to purchase all raw unedited files +$50
pets.outdoorDescription: This one's for the adventure pets! We head to a park, beach, or favorite outdoor spot to capture your pet's energy and personality in motion. Leashes are recommended, we can edit them out later for clean, natural shots.
pets.photobooksDescription: Turn your session into a timeless treasure with a professionally designed, printed photobook. Perfect for displaying your favorite images or gifting to loved ones.
pets.initialContactDescription: Fill out our inquiry form with details about your pet and your vision for the session.
pets.consultationDescription: We'll discuss your pet's personality, preferred locations, and any special requirements.
pets.prepDescription: We'll provide guidance on how to prepare your pet for the best possible photo experience.
pets.sessionDescription: Relaxed, fun photography session tailored to your pet's comfort level and personality.
pets.deliveryDescription: Receive your beautifully edited photos in a private online gallery within 2-3 weeks.
pets.galleryIntro: Explore our gallery of heartwarming pet portraits, capturing the unique personalities and special moments of beloved companions.
pets.faqBring: What should I bring to the photo session?
pets.faqBringAnswer: Bring your pet's favorite treats, toys, and any accessories you'd like to include in the photos. You might want to bring a brush for quick touch-ups. Most importantly, bring patience and a positive attitude!
pets.faqAnxious: How do you handle anxious or energetic pets?
pets.faqAnxiousAnswer: We take a patient, relaxed approach and let your pet set the pace. We'll take breaks as needed and use positive reinforcement. For high-energy pets, we might start with action shots to help them burn off energy before moving to posed photos.
pets.faqDuration: How long does a typical session last?
pets.faqDurationAnswer: Most sessions last about 1 hour. This gives us plenty of time to let your pet get comfortable and capture their true personality.
pets.faqTravelAnswer: Travel within 20 miles of Vancouver downtown is included. Locations beyond that are subject to a $1/mile travel fee.
pets.faqLeash: Can my pet stay on a leash?
pets.faqLeashAnswer: Absolutely, and I actually recommend it. Leashes can be edited out during post-processing if you prefer.
pets.faqTogether: Can I be in the photos too?
pets.faqTogetherAnswer: Yes, absolutely! You're welcome to be part of the session with your pet. Whether it's a sweet cuddle, a walk together, or a playful moment—these are often the most meaningful shots.
pets.about: Specializing in capturing the unique personality and spirit of your pets through professional photography. Based in Vancouver.
